artifact_observations.reasoning: Three umbrellas are stacked on a single shaft in a physically impossible manner for standard handheld umbrellas. The spacing and connection points between the canopies lack realistic mechanical hardware (runners/stretchers) to hold them apart at those specific intervals. It looks like a fused object rather than three separate functional items.

The wheels on the toy trucks appear slightly melted or fused to the chassis in some instances, lacking clear separation gaps typical of toy manufacturing. Tire tread details are also somewhat smudged.
The flames are remarkably uniform in shape and size, lacking the natural chaotic flicker and variation expected from six independent heat sources, suggesting a pattern-copying artifact.
